Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: this PR is the skills-docs half (`skills/objectstack-ai`) owed by PR #37215 (`Skills-docs: follow-up owed — skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md`); the `ask_ai` action itself shipped in PR #37215

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：用 AI 搭建应用时，AI 读到的技能说明现在会教「问 AI」按钮怎么放：放在记录页标题栏或更多菜单，点开后助手钉在这条记录上；并说明它不能带目标、不能开放给 AI 当工具、不能放在仪表盘标题，且只在装了应用内助手的版本里出现。只有文字变化。
- 为什么做：属于「在一条记录上问 AI」专题，补上「问 AI」动作合并后欠下的技能说明。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是说明写得不准，AI 写出的动作仍会被校验拦住；撤回即恢复旧文字。
- 要你做什么：受治理的技能文件，需要你批准后合并。

## What changes

`skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md`, a new subsection *The Ask AI button — `type: 'ask_ai'`* at the end of *Actions as AI Tools*:

- What the action does: it pins the assistant's conversation to the record it runs on and opens the assistant, sending no message. It is declared on the object, in `locations: ['record_header']` or `['record_more']`, with a `defineAction` example marked `os:check` (type-checked against the built spec by `check:skill-examples`).
- What the parse refuses beside it: a `target`, `ai.exposed: true`, and `actionType: 'ask_ai'` on a dashboard header (a header runs on no record).
- That nothing serves it headless: `list_actions` skips it, `run_action` refuses it, and no `action_` tool exists for it.
- Where it is absent rather than disabled: the console draws it only where the assistant surface is on **and** the AI service honours a conversation focus.

Paid for by deleting restatement in the same file; the token ceiling is unchanged (6801, the file measures 6787). Deleted: the *App AI Blueprint* table (its first two rows restate *Skill Configuration* and the `KnowledgeServicePlugin` wiring; its third row's claim that `agents` / `tools` / `skills` are the only AI stack collections was stale, since `aiContexts` is a `defineStack` key too); the alias sentence under *Platform agents* (`data_chat` / `metadata_assistant` for old bookmarks: the agent type is closed to third parties, so no author writes either); the pointer to `references/_index.md` for `AgentSchema` (the *References* section already points there); the rung-2 sentence "Read that file for the exact set" (the sentence before it names the file); the two product-analogy parentheticals beside `ask` and `build`; and the memory clause of pitfall 1, kept to its two facts (the required keys and that there is no storage backend to choose).

`evals/skills-tools-knowledge.json`:

- New case 10: "Add an Ask AI button to the contract record page". Expected: a `defineAction` with `type: 'ask_ai'`, `objectName: 'contract'`, `locations: ['record_header']`, no `target`, no `ai.exposed: true`, with the headless and absent-not-disabled facts. Assertions: must contain `ask_ai`, `record_header`, `locations`; must not contain `target:` (only that token: a correct answer may well spell `exposed: true` or `actionType` while stating the refusals, so neither can be forbidden under the grader's literal-substring rule).
- Case 9 (declared extra item, same kind of edit in the same file, asked for in the contract review): its reference answer no longer spells the `chunkSize` token it forbids (it now says "no chunk-size key"); the assertions are unchanged.

Changeset `.changeset/37217-skill-ask-ai-action.md`: `@objectstack/skills` patch, carrying the two declaration lines.

Out of scope, left where it lives: the `objectstack-ui` action-type row (landed in PR #37215); the `ai_context` teaching (#37177, same skill tree, unclaimed until this lands).

## Why

PR #37215 (#37142) added the `ask_ai` action type and its console executor, and declared `Skills-docs: follow-up owed — skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md`. The UI skill's action-type table has the row; the AI skill, the one an author reads when wiring the assistant, did not mention the action, so an agent asked for an Ask AI button would reach for `ai.exposed: true` or a `target`, both refused at parse.

## Verification

Every claim in the new passage rests on `main` at 98bda0ac: `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts` (`ActionType` carries `ask_ai`; `TARGETLESS_TYPES`; `refuseAskAiContradictions` refuses `target` and `ai.exposed: true`), `packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.zod.ts` (`refuseRecordlessAskAi` on the header action), `packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts` (`isHeadlessInvokableAction` answers `false`; the door's `ask_ai` sentence), `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useAiSurface.ts` (`enabled` + `focusServed`, `capabilities.focus`) and `useAskAiHandler.ts`, `docs/adr/0160-record-scoped-ai-inquiry.md` D7, and `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/actions/index.ts` (`showcase_ask_about_task`, the same shape as the example).

The bundle grows by 218 tokens: +231 in the unratcheted eval fixture (2444 to 2675), −13 in ratcheted authored text.

Rework at 05555e04 (contract review 7178774511, PASS with two should-fixes and a nit): the changeset's token count reads 6787 (measured), the Blueprint-row reason says stale rather than restated, case 10's `must_not_contain` keeps only `target:`, and case 9's reference drops the literal `chunkSize`. The grader the cases declare (`packages/qa/scenarios/src/skill-evals/grade.ts`, `gradeAnswer`) run over each case's own `expected_output`:

```
== head e16ec49d (before the fix) ==
case 9: pass=false missing=[] forbidden=["chunkSize"]
case 10: pass=false missing=[] forbidden=["exposed: true"]
== head 05555e04 (after the fix) ==
case 9: pass=true missing=[] forbidden=[]
case 10: pass=true missing=[] forbidden=[]
```

Re-run on the new head: `check-skills-token-ratchet` (6787/6801), `check-empty-changeset`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check:nul-bytes`, all exit 0; `check-commit-card-trailers --range origin/main..HEAD` exit 0 (2 commits); `overlap-check --branch=HEAD` VERDICT clean. The skill file is byte-identical to e16ec49d, so the gates below still describe it.

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 49 commands (run from the committed head, reconciled with `--ran`: 49 derived, 48 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN). 48 ran locally, all exit 0, including `check-skills-token-ratchet` (gate and `--self-test`), `@objectstack/spec check:skill-docs`, `check:skill-links`, `check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `check:skill-compatibility`, `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:corpus-claim-drift`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:role-word`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check:pm-governed-merges`, `check:published-files`, `check:dts-closure`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `@objectstack/lint check:doc-formula-expressions`.

NOT MEASURED locally, left to CI: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (exit 3, prerequisite: reads every package's built `dist`; only `spec`, `client`, `client-react` and their closure were built here). The diff touches no package source.

Outside the derived set, run because the card's acceptance names it: `@objectstack/spec check:skill-examples` exit 0 — 351 marked examples across 3 surfaces type-check, the new `os:check` block included (`tsc` ran the semantic pass on all of them, against the built `@objectstack/spec`).

Pre-push: `check-commit-card-trailers --range origin/main..HEAD` exit 0; `overlap-check --branch=HEAD` VERDICT clean (origin/main and the one open PR sharing `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md`, #35129, both merge cleanly).
</details>

No ablation: the change is docs and an eval fixture; no tested behaviour moved.

Two-minute check: read *The Ask AI button* in `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` beside `refuseAskAiContradictions` in `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts` and D7 of ADR-0160.

## Acceptance notes

- Built by the card thread itself on claude-fable-5-1 under the measured-unavailability exemption recorded in the claim (comment 7177961994: `dispatch-gates --tier` mandates claude-fable-5-2 for `skills/**`; this account serves 5-1). The compensating control is the contract review at CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER, owed on the handoff.
- None filed.

- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (repo-wide lint is CI's run; the diff touches only Markdown and JSON)

- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
